title: Guideline Value vs Market Value in Puducherry, Explained
description: Guideline value is the government’s minimum for stamp duty; market value is what a buyer pays. Why they differ and why both matter when you sell.
h1: Guideline value vs market value in Puducherry, and why they differ
lead: Sellers often confuse two numbers. One is set by the government for tax purposes; the other is set by buyers.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

paras: Guideline value is a rate set by the government for a locality, used as a reference for stamp duty and registration. It is revised from time to time and applies to areas or categories of land, not to your individual property.
Market value is what a willing buyer will actually pay for your specific property today. It reflects road, frontage, approval, condition, demand and the buyer’s alternatives.

Guideline values move slowly and by area, while the market moves by street and by month. In some places the market is well above the guideline value, in others near it. Neither number alone tells you what to ask.

blocks.h: What it means when you sell
bullets: Stamp duty is generally calculated on the higher figure, so a sale far below guideline value can create problems
Ask for the current guideline value for your exact survey number
Use market evidence, not guideline value, to set the asking price
